subject.title: Plugin approval gateway rejection reported to agent as misleading "gateway unavailable"

question: Which linked PR should maintainers use as the canonical fix for this plugin approval rejection bug before closing this issue?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same catch path with different proof and mergeability states, so automation should not open another fix or close the issue before a maintainer chooses the landing path.

options.title: Use The Proof-Backed Candidate
options.body: Repair or refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100231 if needed, land it as the canonical fix, then close the duplicate candidates and this issue after merge.

options.title: Use A Clean Candidate After Proof
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100228 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100337 as the active PR only after it has the missing real-behavior proof and any review findings are resolved.

options.title: Open A Maintainer Replacement
options.body: Create a narrow maintainer-owned replacement only if none of the contributor branches should carry the final fix.

recommendation.title: Use The Proof-Backed Candidate
recommendation.body: Repair or refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100231 if needed, land it as the canonical fix, then close the duplicate candidates and this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the plugin approval surface, making them the strongest history-backed owner for choosing the canonical fix shape.
